summary: Recent selected submissions emphasize nuclear-geometry identifiability, rapidity-differential critical-point cumulants, saturation-sensitive recoil and diffractive observables, low-energy femtoscopy as an EoS probe, and practical AI/ML workflows for detector imaging and HEP software generation.
strongest_paper_summary: arXiv:2609.01229 gives the most rigorous heavy-ion contribution by quantifying geometric degeneracies in extracting nuclear surface diffuseness from deformation-sensitive observables.

papers.title: Fundamental geometric limitations on disentangling nuclear-surface properties in relativistic heavy ion collisions
papers.short_authors: Hadi Mehrabpour, Behnaz Behzadmoghaddam, S. M. A. Tabatabaee Mehr, Oscar Garcia-Montero, Li Yan
papers.abstract: Studies how surface diffuseness, quadrupole deformation, and octupole deformation become entangled in event-by-event Glauber responses for relativistic heavy-ion observables using response maps, local sensitivity, information geometry, and Bayesian constraints.

papers.title: Unveiling QCD Criticality with Cross-Rapidity Net-Baryon Cumulants
papers.short_authors: Jianing Li, Shuzhe Shi, Lipei Du
papers.abstract: Proposes separated-rapidity net-baryon cumulants to distinguish global baryon-number conservation from long-wavelength critical fluctuations and reduce leading conservation backgrounds.

papers.title: Femtoscopy as a New Probe of the Nuclear Equation of State
papers.short_authors: Xialei Jiang, Jiaxing Zhao, Yingjie Zhou, Xiaofeng Luo
papers.abstract: Uses PHQMD to argue that nuclear mean fields generate low-k* enhancements in two- and higher-order femtoscopic correlations, with sensitivity to EoS stiffness and momentum dependence.

papers.title: Spin transport in intermediate-energy heavy-ion collisions
papers.abstract: Invited mini-review of spin- and isospin-dependent BUU simulations and spin-sensitive observables in intermediate-energy heavy-ion collisions.

papers.title: Impact of nuclear triaxial deformation on electromagnetic fields in relativistic Xe+Xe collisions
papers.short_authors: Maidi Huang, Jin Hu, Yunpeng Liu, Baoyi Chen
papers.abstract: Calculates electric and magnetic field distributions in 129Xe+129Xe at 5.44 TeV with triaxially deformed Woods-Saxon densities.

papers.title: Recoil Geometry Unmasks Gluon Saturation in Forward Z0 Production
papers.short_authors: Wanchen Li, Ding Yu Shao, Shu-Yi Wei, Jian Zhou
papers.abstract: Combines CGC and SCET to propose fiducial recoil subtraction in forward Z production as a way to recover saturation-sensitive nuclear broadening from perturbative radiation.

papers.title: Saturation effects in diffractive deep inelastic scattering
papers.short_authors: Jani Penttala, Christophe Royon, Jarno Vierros
papers.abstract: Compares inclusive and diffractive heavy-quark photoproduction with BK and BFKL dipole evolution, emphasizing UPC sensitivity to saturation.

papers.title: Neural-Network-Based Variational Method in Nuclear Density Functional Theory: Application to the Kohn-Sham method
papers.abstract: Represents Kohn-Sham orbitals with neural networks and compares to Skyrme-Hartree-Fock plus nuclear-pasta benchmarks.

papers.title: Panda Diplomacy: Foundation Model Pre-training across Particle Imaging Detectors for High Energy and Nuclear Physics
papers.short_authors: Samuel Young, Cesar Jesus-Valls, Kazuhiro Terao
papers.abstract: Tests a point-cloud self-distillation foundation model across LArTPC, collider TPC, and water-Cherenkov detector modalities with strong label-efficiency claims.

papers.title: Reliable LLM-Generated Programs for High-Energy Physics Experiments through Graph-Grounded Software Knowledge
papers.short_authors: Yue Sun, Tong Liu, Yipu Liao, Jingde Chen, Ke Li
papers.abstract: Grounds LLM code generation with retrieval over a software knowledge graph, workflow examples, and execution repair, improving success on 275 ROOT tasks.

papers.title: Validating a BDT-based Electron-Positron Identification Algorithm at CLAS12 with Experimental Data
papers.short_authors: Mariana Tenorio Pita, Pierre Chatagnon, Richard Tyson
papers.abstract: Simulation-trained BDT electron/positron PID models are validated on CLAS12 data, reporting high lepton retention and reduced pion contamination.

cautions.title: Reining in an Agentic Harness for High Energy Physics
cautions.short_authors: Tony Menzo, George T. Fleming, Konstantin T. Matchev, Stephen Mrenna, Alexander Roman
cautions.abstract: Position paper on versioned scientific operations, protocols, registries, and machine-readable contracts for HEP agentic workflows.
